user_goal: Complete the authorized browser pop-out and persistent private connector while keeping its generated machine-local record out of Git.

authority.verbatim_text: Authorized Plotkeeper change: Complete the authorized browser pop-out and persistent private connector while keeping its generated machine-local record out of Git.

baseline.protected_ref: validated responsive-picker candidate before connector implementation
baseline.protection_evidence: clean single main worktree at parent contract activation
baseline.selection_reason: Preserves the exact preimplementation baseline while adding only the generated-state ignore path omitted from the parent contract.

semantic_changes: Implement the parent contract's exact pop-out, private connector, lifecycle, ownership, origin, and parity behavior.
Ignore only runtime/plotkeeper-connector.json so generated machine-local connector state never enters source control.
No non-loopback bind, arbitrary URL launch, foreign-process termination, fixed replacement port, run/ledger behavior change, broad ignore rule, release, version bump, or publication.

invariants: The ignore addition names only the generated connector record and hides no source, evidence, ledger, contract, or checkpoint file.
One connector remains stable across install/reinstall and every automatic entry point uses it.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The exact run-bound surface pops into the Windows default browser and one persisted high private loopback connector is used safely everywhere without dirtying Git.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Any parent-contract failure, connector-state commit, broad ignore, fixed-port collision, foreign takeover, URL injection, or entry-point disagreement.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Plotkeeper users, installer, startup, CLI, SpecSwarm, Codex sidebar, local service, and source repository.

proof_requirements.claim: Real browser, isolated lifecycle, foreign-listener, origin/path attack, connector parity, Git-ignore, full-suite, and live-installed checks prove the complete behavior.
proof_requirements.required_environment: isolated Z-drive installation plus installed local Plotkeeper and real browser
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: parent proof commands plus git check-ignore and exact diff audit
proof_requirements.expected_observation: all parent acceptance behavior passes, generated connector is ignored, and no unrelated file or process changes

review_requirements.required_role: independent security, lifecycle, UI, and scope reviewer

release_requirements.required_receipt: validated local installed behavior only; publication requires a separate release contract

stop_conditions: Any parent stop condition, broad ignore match, connector record tracked/unignored, failed exact-diff review, or missing independent PASS.
known_discrepancies: The parent sealed contract omitted .gitignore even though its required generated runtime/plotkeeper-connector.json record must remain machine-local.

requirement_trace.authority: User-authorized external pop-out and non-colliding obscure connector
